IS 814 : 2004 Covered Electrodes for Manual Metal Arc Welding of Carbon and Carbon Manganese Steel - SpecificationICS 25.160.20; 77.080.20MTD 11Reaffirmed 20211 ScopeThis standard specifies the requirements for covered carbon andcarbon manganese steel electrodes for carbon and carbon manganesesteel, including hydrogen controlled electrodes for manual metalarc welding of mild and medium tensile steels including structuralsteels, depositing weld metal having a tensile strength not morethan 610 MPa.Electrodes designed specifically for repair welding, oftenmarketed in India as `low heat input' electrodes are not covered inthis standard.Ilmenite type electrodes are being used fairly widely in fewother countries. There appears to be a trend to use ilmenite as aningredient of the covering in our country also. Provision for aseparate class for such electrode may be considered at a laterstage.Note - For weld metal with tensile strength higher than 610 MPa,a reference maybe made of IS 1395.2 ReferencesIS 812 : 1957Glossary of terms relating to welding and cutting of metalsIS 1182 : 1983Recommended  practice for radiographic examination of fusion welded butt joints in steel platesIS 1387 : 1993General requirements for the supply of metallurgical materialsIS 1395 : 1982Low and medium alloy steel covered electrodes for manual metal arc weldingIS 1599 : 1985Method for bend testIS 1608 : 1995Mechanical testing of metals - Tensile testingIS 1757 : 1988Method for charpy impact test (V-notch) for metallic materialsIS 1977 : 1996Low tensile structural steelIS 2002 : 1992Steel plates for pressure vessels for intermediate and high temperature service including boilersIS 2062 : 1999Steel for general structural purposesIS 2879 : 1998Mild steel for metal arc welding electrodesIS 3039 : 1988Structural steel for construction of hulls of shipIS 8500 : 1991Structural steel - Micro-alloyed (medium and high strength qualities) - SpecificationIS 11802 : 1986Method for determination of diffusible hydrogen content of deposited weld metal from covered electrodes in welding mild and low alloy steelsIS 13043 : 1991Covered manual metal arc welding electrodes - Determination of efficiency, metal recovery and deposition coefficientIS 13851 : 1993Storage and redrying of covered electrodes before use - Recommendations
